summary: Rabbi Harari discusses whether the practice of Shnayim Mikra ve'echad Targum includes reading the Haftarah. He examines the differing rationales provided by early authorities and explains why the Shulhan Arukh does not require it, noting that current practices in the knis often make the preparation unnecessary.
questions: Is it mandatory to read the Haftarah as part of Shnayim Mikra?
Why does the Shulhan Arukh not mention reading the Haftarah?
What is the difference between the approaches of Rabbeinu Simcha and Rabbeinu Hananel?
Does the practice of reading the Haftarah change if someone else is reading it in the knis?
Should I read the Haftarah even if it is not required?
